Portfolio Engine predictions, MPT Optimization, and the AI
Recommendation Engine, all in one call (matching ai-service's own

MessageResponse.title: MessageResponse
MessageResponse.description:
Generic success acknowledgement for endpoints that don't return a
resource — used for endpoints where the response must be identical
whether or not the underlying account exists (Document 6 §15.1
enumeration mitigation: request-verification-email, request-password-
reset both return this same shape regardless).

message.title: Message
message.default: Registration successful. Please check your email to verify your account.

error.title: Error
error.description: Set if this item's quote could not be fetched

WatchlistItemQuoteResponse.title: WatchlistItemQuoteResponse
WatchlistItemQuoteResponse.description:
Live market-data enrichment for a single watchlist item — Phase 4/5
integration point. `is_delayed` mirrors GetCurrentPriceUseCase's
is_stale_fallback flag (renamed for the frontend-facing "delayed
indicator" the founder explicitly requested), so a stale/cached quote
is always honestly labeled, never silently presented as live.

WatchlistSummaryResponse.title: WatchlistSummaryResponse
WatchlistSummaryResponse.description:
Lighter-weight shape for the list endpoint — no items/quotes, since
fetching live prices for every item across every watchlist on a list
call would be an unbounded number of quote lookups. Full item/quote
detail is only returned by GET /watchlists/{id}.
